description:
## Scope
Add guides/developer/backends.md and module docs. Prominently state: ReqLLM.Response is the shared generation response for ALL Jido.AI backends, including local inference; namespace identifies its defining package, not execution origin. Constructing it does not require ReqLLM generation/provider/transport/model resolution. Same distinction applies to shared message/context/tool/tool-call/content-part/chunk types. Do not introduce or describe Backend.Response.
Guide must specify required/optional callbacks, result fields and context semantics, unknown usage/limits, capabilities, model reference/atom alias rules, selection precedence and option merging, reserved execution keys, default ReqLLM behavior, native versus portable streaming, event/terminal/error/backpressure contract, cancellation guarantees, resource/session/continuation ownership, checkpoints, tool-calling and structured-output expectations, unsupported-operation errors and no silent backend fallback.
Include a small deterministic custom backend constructing real ReqLLM.Response directly and returning portable streams, plus contract test guidance. Explain how an external Nx/Serving adapter would translate native structures, configure serving/deployment references and own model lifecycle; actual Nx implementation/dependencies remain outside scope. Local backend examples configure appropriate models rather than reusing remote defaults implicitly.
Update README.md, usage-rules.md, guides/user/{llm_facade_quickstart,standalone_react_runtime}.md, guides/developer/{configuration_reference,architecture_and_runtime_flow,directives_runtime_contract,error_model_and_recovery}.md, relevant module docs and ExDoc grouping in mix.exs. Do not edit CHANGELOG.md.

## Acceptance criteria
- New users need no backend configuration for existing ReqLLM behavior.
- Backend author can implement a generation-only/embedding-only backend from the documented contract without assuming ReqLLM execution.
- Native stream_text/2 compatibility and stream_format: :backend are unambiguous.
- Examples match final callback signatures and pass validation; mix docs succeeds.
- Review epic definition of done and document verified results/blockers before any implementation completion is claimed.

## Suggested commit
docs(backend): document implementation and compatibility contracts
